Name: Goldstar Valley - Warp Totem Retexture
Author: Goldilocksexe
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vdY8SVn.png[/img]﻿
[font=Courier New][size=3]
[b]Goldstar Valley[/b] is an ongoing mod series that aims to replace all vanilla art in a more cohesive, clean, and cute style. Ideally, Goldstar Valley will eventually include replacers for visuals from other mods as well. Please feel free to suggest mods you'd like me to retexture!

[/size][/font][img]https://i.imgur.com/EzDddkr.png[/img]
[font=Courier New][size=3]
[b]Goldstar Valley - Warp Totem Retexture[/b] replaces Warp Totem sprites with my art style and aims to make totems look more like talismans. Not a huge modder but want totems to look a little more consistent? Very into modding and want your totems to match the rest of your pretty pastel Pelican Town? Somewhere in between? This mod is for you!
Currently, [b]Goldstar Valley - Warp Totem Retexture[/b] changes the following sprites:
[u][b]Vanilla: [/b]Warp Totem: Beach, Warp Totem: Desert, Warp Totem: Farm, Warp Totem: Island, Warp Totem: Mountains, Rain Totem
[b]Stardew Valley Expanded:[/b] Sun Totem, Wind Totem
[/u][u][b]Ridgeside Village: [/b]Warp Totem: Ridgeside
[/u][u][b]East Scarp: [/b]Warp Totem: East Scarp
[/u][u][b]Sunberry Village:[/b] Warp Totem: Sunberry
[b]Cape Stardew: [/b]Warp Totem: Cape Stardew, Warp Totem: Sea Cape Stardew
[/u][u][b]Mineral Town: [/b]Warp Totem: Mineral Town[/u]
[/size][/font]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uaAQms0.png[/img]
[font=Courier New]
[size=3][b]Goldstar Valley - Warp Totem Retexture[/b] can be installed or uninstalled at any time during your playthrough!
[/size][b]NOTE: If you use East Scarp Remastered (or don't use any version of East Scarp at all), download the latest version. If you still use the old East Scarp, download the Miscellaneous file![/b]
[size=2]1. Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]downloaded and have run it to install. Directions on how to do so can be found [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]here[/url]!
2. Download, unzip, and drag [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] into your Stardew Valley mods folder OR download using a mod manager.
3. If you'd like to configure certain aspects of this mod (detailed below), please download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], unzip it, and drag it to your mods folder OR download using a mod manager.
4. Download this mod's file, unzip it, and drag it into your mods folder OR download using a mod manager.
5. Enjoy![/size][/font]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CBjZzpQ.png[/img]

[font=Courier New][size=3]The easiest way to configure this mod is by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿. All changes can be made in-game and without the hassle of messing with file contents! For more info on how that mod works, please visit its page.
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=2][b]Enable Mod[/b]: Easily turn the entire mod on or off!
[b]Color Scheme[/b]: Choose between saturated sprites (best fit for more vanilla playthroughs or for those who like bright colors) or desaturated sprites (best fit for aesthetic modlists)! My personal favorite is saturated. Images of saturated versus desaturated can be found on this mod page under "Images" or in the mod's file, for reference. Mod has to be enabled for these changes to take place.
[b]Sprite Toggle[/b]: Don't like a specific retexture in the mod? Just turn it off! The sprite will now return to its vanilla texture or the texture of any other sprite replacer you have downloaded. Mod has to be enabled for these changes to take place.
[/size][b]Compatibility Toggle: [/b]Turn on sprites for warp totems added by other mods to match mine!

[/font][font=Courier New][size=3]Any of these changes can be made mid-save safely![/size]
[/font]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y9zKO4P.png[/img]

[font=Courier New][size=3][b]Goldstar Valley - Warp Totem Retexture[/b] is compatible with any and all mods. The only exception to this is in the occasion that you have another mod that replaces the same sprites as this mod. In that case, both mods will still work, but whichever mod SMAPI loads first will take precedence. Feel free to toggle certain sprites on or off to ensure that you see the retextures you want to see!
[/size][/font]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NsZLs3I.png[/img]

[font=Courier New][size=3][b]Q: Will you include compatibility with other mods that add Warp Totems down the line?
[/b]A: Yes! Currently, this mod optionally replaces Warp Totems from Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, Sunberry Village, Cape Stardew, and Mineral Town as well as the Weather Totems in vanilla and Stardew Valley Expanded. I'm now working on adding sprites for Mount Vapius.

[b]Q: Does this mod affect using the Warp Totems in the sewing machine?
[/b]A: Nope. The Warp Totems will still produce the vanilla Totem Mask!

[b]Q: Is this mod compatible with East Scarp Remastered?
[/b]A: Yes, it is! If you use East Scarp Remastered (or don't use any version of East Scarp at all), download the latest version. If you still use the old East Scarp, download the Miscellaneous file!

Please feel free to leave other questions in the comments section!
[/size][/font]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BDZr8Pw.png[/img]

[font=Courier New][size=3]As always, all downloads, endorsements, kind words, and constructive criticism is appreciated. If you are able and willing, feel free to support my work below or donate to put me through college!
[/size][/font]
